root_cause: Kubernetes ConfigMap update was not followed by a rolling pod restart.
resolution: Updated Kubernetes ConfigMap, restarted pods, and added startup health check validation.

title: [P2] Third-Party API Outage in Inventory Management
symptoms: External API provider returning HTTP 503 Service Unavailable.
root_cause: Upstream vendor experienced regional outage in us-east-1.
resolution: Enabled circuit breaker fallback to cached response data until vendor recovery.

title: [P4] Memory Leak / OOM in Authentication Service
symptoms: Container pods restarting continuously due to OOMKilled exit code 137.
root_cause: Unbounded cache growth in memory without TTL eviction policy.
resolution: Increased container memory limit from 2GB to 4GB temporarily and deployed patch implementing LRU cache eviction.

title: [P2] Kafka Consumer Lag Spike in SendGrid Email Relay

root_cause: Consumer thread pool deadlock during message deserialization batching.
resolution: Increased Kafka consumer group concurrency and scaled consumer pods.

symptoms: Kong gateway returning 504 Gateway Timeout on downstream calls to Catalog PostgreSQL DB.
root_cause: Downstream service Catalog PostgreSQL DB thread pool saturated due to slow database queries.
resolution: Scaled up downstream service replicas from 3 to 8 and optimized database index on frequently queried table.

title: [P3] Deployment Regression in Kong API Gateway

root_cause: Database migration script failed to add required column before application code execution.
resolution: Rolled back deployment to previous stable version (v1.4.2) and applied missing database migration manually.
